content:
lumbre-api 完整文件清单（全部已写入 /data/lumbre-api/）：
- package.json: express ^4.21, cors ^2.8.5, tsx ^4.16, typescript ^5.5, @types/*
- tsconfig.json: target ES2022, module NodeNext, outDir dist
- .env.example: CLAUDE_API_KEY, BRAIN_API_BASE, DATA_DIR, PORT=3001, CORS_ORIGIN
- .gitignore: node_modules, dist, .env, data/
- src/index.ts: Express 入口，CORS + 5个路由挂载 + /health
- src/routes/chat.ts: Anthropic/OpenAI proxy + tool-use loop (MAX 15 iter)
- src/routes/diary.ts: read/write/comment/update/delete/unlock/password
- src/routes/notes.ts: read/write/reply/delete
- src/routes/memory.ts: search(breath)/pulse/hold/trace/dream
- src/routes/models.ts: model list endpoint
- src/services/brain-client.ts: MCP SSE client (copied from Lumbre)
- src/services/diary-store.ts: file-based diary+notes (copied from Lumbre)
- src/services/tools.ts: tool defs + executeTool dispatcher

下一步：
1. shell 恢复后 → git init, 连 GitHub repo, push
2. Zeabur 新建服务 → 关联 lumbre-api repo → 设环境变量
3. 前端 Lumbre: 删 src/app/api/ 和 src/server/，api.ts 改 fetch 目标为 NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL
4. 前端推送，Zeabur 重新部署
